title: Bridging Human and Model Attention: Explainability Analysis of CNN, Mamba, and ViT Architectures with Gaze-Based Validation
title_zh: 连接人类与模型注意力：基于眼动验证的 CNN、Mamba 和 ViT 架构的可解释性分析

paragraphs.en: 本文通过眼动验证评估了CNN、ViT和Mamba架构的可解释性，并发现不同架构在匹配人类视觉感知方面表现出不同的特性。 High-risk applications of deep learning require precise characterization of model decision-making. We conduct a systematic explainability evaluation across Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Vision Transformers (ViTs), and Vision Mamba (ViM). Unlike predominantly qualitative studies, we quantify the alignment between model attention and human visual perception using eye-tracking ground truth. We formalize this comparison via a standardized normalization pipeline mapping post-hoc attribution maps and gaze heatmaps onto spatial probability distributions. Alignment is evaluated across fine-grained classification, medical imaging, and emotion recognition using architecture-specific XAI methods. We measure fidelity using Jensen-Shannon similarity, Chi-square similarity, and Pearson correlation, three complementary estimators capturing support overlap, mass discrepancy, and structural co-variation. Our results reveal distinct attention dynamics: CNNs tend to exhibit a more global focus, with spatially more diffuse saliency maps that correlate well with human perception in general contexts, while ViTs demonstrate fine-grained, patch-level attention, often focused on discriminative microfeatures. The Mamba architecture shows biased behavior: it achieves strong explainability in medical tasks but exhibits divergent intensity distributions in natural images; our analytical characterization of the metrics makes this dissociation explicit, since near-unit support overlap is attained simultaneously with a vanishing linear correlation. We further analyze the effect of backbone freezing and ensemble strategies on model interpretability. The results highlight how architectural and training choices influence the alignment between model saliency and human visual attention.
paragraphs.zh: 本文通过眼动验证评估了CNN、ViT和Mamba架构的可解释性，并发现不同架构在匹配人类视觉感知方面表现出不同的特性。深度学习的高风险应用需要精确刻画模型的决策过程。 我们对卷积神经网络（CNN）、视觉变换器（ViT）和视觉Mamba（ViM）进行了系统性的可解释性评估。 与大多数定性研究不同，我们利用眼动追踪的真实数据，量化了模型注意力与人类视觉感知之间的匹配程度。 我们通过标准化的归一化流程将事后归因图和注视热图映射到空间概率分布上，从而正式化这一比较。 我们使用针对各架构的XAI方法，在细粒度分类、医学影像和情绪识别任务中评估了这种匹配度。 我们采用Jensen-Shannon相似性、Chi-square相似性和Pearson相关性这三种互补的估计指标来衡量保真度，分别捕捉支持集的重叠、质量差异和结构共变。 我们的结果揭示了不同的注意力动态：CNN倾向于表现出更全局的关注点，其空间分布更分散的显著性图在一般情境下与人类感知高度相关；而ViT则展现出细粒度的块级注意力，通常聚焦于具有区分性的微观特征。 Mamba架构表现出偏差行为：它在医学任务中实现了强可解释性，但在自然图像中却呈现出差异化的强度分布；我们对指标的分析性刻画明确揭示了这种分离现象——支持集的重叠接近1的同时，线性相关性却趋近于零。 我们进一步分析了冻结主干网络和集成策略对模型可解释性的影响。 研究结果凸显了架构和训练选择如何影响模型显著性与人类视觉注意力之间的匹配程度。
